title: A Space's own accent carries white button labels, like the house amber

source.ref: Owner ask 2026-10-07: 'The button is supposed to be white text on blue. We changed the rules about contrast because white looks just fine on the buttons.' ADR-1722, extends ADR-1031.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-07. THE CONSEQUENCE: a Space with a mid-tone picked accent (Daniel Tyack's #1FB6C5) showed its Book button, on the Space page and its website, with near-black ink instead of the white label the house buttons carry. THE FIX: hexAccentVars labels every accent in white (ADR-1031's owner rule, extended by ADR-1722); only a near-white fill, under 1.5:1 against white, keeps near-black ink.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('lib/spaces/accent.ts','utf8');if(!/contrastRatio\('#ffffff', hex\) >= WHITE_LABEL_MIN \? '#ffffff' : '#141414'/.test(s)){console.error('LIVE-833: a Space accent button label is still chosen by the luminance crossover, so mid-tone accents get dark ink');process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails on main (luminance crossover picks dark ink); passes once this lands.
